payout_quote: 1) Open a new business checking account by 12/29/2026 using Promo Code FCBIZ2. 2) Complete 10 or more qualifying transactions that post and clear the account within 60 days of account opening. 3) Complete $3,000 or more in cumulative deposits within 60 days of account opening. The amount of new money deposited with determine your offer amount. | Business Checking Offer Amount: $300 = $3,000 - $4,999; $500 = $5,000 or more.
steps: Open a new First Commonwealth Bank business checking account by 12/29/2026 with promo code FCBIZ2 (businesses in PA, OH, IN, KY, or WV; EIN must not already have a First Commonwealth checking account; $50 minimum deposit).
Within 60 days of opening: complete 10+ qualifying transactions (debit card purchases, ACH debits, wires) that post and clear, and deposit $3,000+ in cumulative new money.
Eligibility is determined 60 days after opening; the $300 (for $3,000-$4,999) or $500 (for $5,000+) reward is deposited as a 'Promotional Credit' within 120 days of account opening.

Eligibility determined 60 days after opening; reward deposited into active accounts within 120 days of account opening as a 'Promotional Credit'.
$50 minimum to open business checking; reward value may be reported on IRS Form 1099 (taxable).
